title: My Favorite Things
text:
My bag is made of soft leather. It is brown and smooth. The leather is strong, so the bag is good for school.

My scarf is made of wool. It is warm and a little rough. My grandmother knitted it for me in winter.

questions.text: What is the scarf made of?
How does the writer probably feel about the bag?
options: The writer is angry about the bag.
The writer wants to sell the bag.
The writer is happy with the bag.

questions.text: Who probably gave the scarf to the writer?

vocabulary.definition: a material made from the skin of an animal
having a comfortable, not cold, temperature

paragraph_translations: Моя сумка зроблена з м'якої шкіри. Вона коричнева і гладенька. Шкіра міцна, тому сумка добра для школи.
Мій шарф зроблений з вовни. Він теплий і трохи шорсткий. Моя бабуся зв'язала його для мене взимку.
